## Fixed
- **Transmitters no longer get stuck on next to their own receiver.** A transmitter placed within a block of a receiver on the same channel and frequency could latch on: once its redstone input (lever, comparator, etc.) switched it on, it stayed on even after that input turned off — or was removed entirely. Transmitters now ignore the signal from receivers on their own channel when reading their input, so they release correctly. Receivers driving a transmitter on a *different* channel are unaffected.
